# Vision Capture

> High-quality, ethically-sourced egocentric video and multimodal datasets for Physical AI, robotics, and embodied foundation models.

Vision Capture (https://visioncapture.in) is India's premier AI data collection platform specializing in large-scale first-person (POV) egocentric sensor capture across everyday household, industrial, commercial, and outdoor environments. We provide AI research labs, autonomous robotics teams, and enterprise model developers with authentic human demonstration datasets required to train Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, spatial intelligence algorithms, and robotic manipulation policies.

## Key Facts & Capabilities
- **Domain Specialization**: Physical AI, Embodied Robotics, Human Demonstration Learning, Spatial Intelligence.
- **Hardware Modalities**: Smart glasses (Meta Ray-Ban), action cameras (GoPro HERO POV mounts), head/chest smartphone rigs (iPhone 11+, Pixel 6+, Galaxy S21+), and multi-channel binaural audio.
- **Resolution & Frame Rates**: 4K UHD, 1080p high-bitrate, 30fps/60fps with synchronized IMU and timestamp metadata.
- **Privacy & Ethics**: Built-in automated bystander facial anonymization, vehicle license plate blurring, strict informed consent, and an absolute commitment to peaceful, civilian research (no defense or military applications).
- **Global Contributor Network**: Verified contributors capturing everyday real-world tasks across diverse cultural, geographic, and socio-economic contexts.
